CaptureMetadata.description:
Optional EXIF/capture metadata for a single photographed image.

Every field is optional — a synthetic or metadata-stripped image simply
omits them. ``exif`` is a free-form bag for tags not modelled explicitly so
a capture pipeline can preserve provenance without a schema change.
CaptureMetadata.title: CaptureMetadata

ImageSetImageEntry.description: One source image in the ordered image set.

image_id.description: Stable, author-supplied identifier for this image. Must be unique within the manifest; ingest refuses duplicates. Used verbatim as the artifact entity id, so it is restricted to a filesystem-safe charset.
image_id.title: Image Id

path.description: Relative path to the image file, resolved against the manifest's own directory. Must stay under the repository root after realpath resolution — ingest refuses traversal, absolute escapes, and symlink escapes.
path.title: Path

media_type.description: Optional IANA media type hint (e.g. ``image/png``). When empty, ingest derives it from the decoded image format.
media_type.title: Media Type
